shortBulletSummary: Crypto market in 'Extreme Fear' with Bitcoin trading near $60,000, as Fear & Greed Index hits extreme fear territory.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw nearly $5 billion in net withdrawals in November, indicating weak institutional demand.
Higher-than-expected US PCE inflation (3.8%) increases fears of a December Federal Reserve interest rate hike.
US House advances legislation (H.R. 8957) to lock up government-held Bitcoin for 20 years, potentially easing supply concerns.
Switzerland approved 57 partners for automatic cryptoasset tax information exchange starting in 2028, adhering to OECD standards.
